MAR.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI named is inside customs, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: Morocco's customs administration (ADII) reports that in 2024 its BADR system, described as applied artificial intelligence, processed 1,540 fraud alerts and was enriched by 434 new rules and 199 updates, alongside predictive algorithms for targeting.
The ADII 2024 activity report says algorithm-based targeting detected 34 MDH of evaded duties and taxes (24 MDH in 2023), of which 20 MDH was recovered and 14 MDH levied as fines.

MAR.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built in the country is stated.

facts.fact: The ADII 2024 activity report says the number of customs declarations rose 7.1% to pass two million for the first time, processed through its BADR system.

MAR.note: Revenue totals given, but no electronic payment of taxes or fees is stated.
